Job Purpose / Summary

The Administrative Specialist is responsible for ensuring smooth and efficient day-to-day operations of the office. This role supports managers and employees through a variety of organizational and communication tasks, acting as a central point for internal and external coordination.

Key Responsibilities

- Oversee daily office operations, including reception duties, mail handling, and supply management.
- Coordinate and organize meetings, appointments, travel arrangements, and company events.
- Maintain and update company records, files, and databases.
- Support HR with onboarding of new employees (e.g., preparing workstations, access cards etc.).
- Liaise with vendors and service providers (office equipment, cleaning, maintenance, couriers).
- Prepare reports, presentations, and correspondence as required.
- Ensure compliance with health, safety, and security procedures in the office.
- Support other departments with administrative tasks when needed.
- Serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external communication and coordination, ensuring information flows smoothly across teams and stakeholders.
- Identify, evaluate, and arrange suitable office spaces and handle related administrative tasks (e.g., lease negotiations, facility setup, and relocation coordination).

Qualifications & Requirements

- Completed vocational training or Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Management, or a related field (preferred).
- Fluent in English, German
- 2+ years of experience in office administration or a similar role.
- Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook).
- Strong organizational and multitasking skills.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities.
- High level of professionalism and confidentiality.
- Ability to work independently and collaboratively.

Key Competencies

- Organization & Time Management – Ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
- Communication – Clear, professional, and proactive communication skills (written and verbal).
- Problem Solving – Proactive in identifying issues and suggesting solutions.
- Attention to Detail – Ensures accuracy in work and documentation.
- Stakeholder Coordination – Builds positive relationships with internal teams and external partners.

- Full-time position based in [Frankfurt am Main / Germany ].
- Standard office hours [e.g., Monday to Friday, 9:00–18:00].
- Occasional overtime for events or urgent tasks may be required.
- On-site work is required.

To further strengthen our international flight training activities, AutoGyro is looking for a qualified and experienced Gyrocopter Flight Instructor (m/f/d).

In this role, you will be responsible for delivering high quality flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments. You will work in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations as well as internal standards and contribute to maintaining and developing our global training quality.

The position combines hands on flight instruction with close collaboration across engineering, sales and after sales functions. You will operate in an international environment and represent AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context.

The activity is based on site at our location in Hildesheim, with occasional international assignments.

The role can alternatively be structured as a cooperation with self employed flight instructors (m/f/d) or flight schools. This includes the delivery of training under the AutoGyro framework and alignment with defined standards and procedures.

Become part of our dynamic team and actively contribute to the success of our company. You can expect attractive conditions as well as free lunch every day.

Tasks

- Delivery of flight training for gyroplane pilots in both practical and theoretical environments
- Instruction and supervision of students in accordance with applicable German and international aviation regulations and internal standards
- Execution of check flights, proficiency checks and refresher training
- Customer handover flights and aircraft familiarisation
- Assessment of student performance and documentation of training progress
- Contribution to the continuous development of training concepts and standards in line with international requirements
- Close coordination with engineering, sales and after sales in relation to aircraft and customer requirements
- Representation of AutoGyro towards customers and partners in a professional aviation context

Requirements

- Valid Flight Instructor qualification for gyroplane or a comparable instructor licence with willingness to convert
- Proven flight experience, ideally within ultralight or gyroplane aviation
- Strong instructional capability with a structured and safety oriented approach
- Sound understanding of aviation regulations and operational procedures
- High level of responsibility, reliability and professional judgement
- Confident communication skills in English and German
- Willingness to travel occasionally, including international assignments

Benefits

- Dynamic working environment with the global leader in gyroplane manufacturing.
- Comprehensive onboarding and continuous training opportunities.
- Supportive and international team culture.
- Flexible working hours (flexitime) to support work–life balance.
- Corporate fitness programme (Hansefit).
- Employer contributions to the pension scheme.
- Employee discounts via our corporate benefits platform.
- Regular company events that strengthen team spirit.
- Free daily lunch at our headquarter.
- Overtime compensation and additional paid leave for special occasions.
- Unique aviation experience – including a gyrocopter sightseeing flight.

Are you ready for an exciting career in aviation? Then become part of AutoGyro GmbH.

We are the global market leader in the development, production, and sales of gyroplanes, working with partners in more than 40 countries worldwide. Our headquarters and production facility are located at Hildesheim Airport. With state-of-the-art technologies, a high level of in-house manufacturing, and a clear vision for sustainable aviation, we actively shape the future of flight.

Since our founding in 1999, we have grown continuously and today employ an international team of nearly 100 qualified specialists and engineers. With a global sales network, we consistently pursue our mission: to make the fascination of flying, maximum safety, and the versatile applications of gyroplanes accessible worldwide.

Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology. Starting date: as soon as possible, at the latest September 1,2026.

Area of responsibility

The Institute of Physiology and Cell Biology aims to recruit a highly motivated post-doctoral scientistto join the Cell Biology group, headed by Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk. We study how ubiquitination andautophagy control cell survival, programmed cell death, inflammation and cell differentiation inbroad pathophysiological settings, including oncology and infection. For this, human and animalpre-clinical experimental systems, including cell lines, primary cells, organoids and iPSC-derivedcells, will be integrated with cell biology with biochemistry, molecular biology and omicsapproaches, including CRISPR/Cas9 gene editing, super-resolution and confocal microscopy andmass-spectrometry. For examples of recent research, see Wächtershäuser et al, Signal TransductTarget Ther, 11(1):204; Zein et al, Autophagy, 21(5):1075-1095 and Weinelt et al, Cell Death Dis,15(1):77.

The position will be closely involved in shaping the research group, setting up the lab and planningand performing independent research at the interface of cell biology, biochemistry and molecularbiology with imaging and computational data analysis. The successful candidate will play centralroles in collaborations between different scientific and clinical research groups and in developinginnovative approaches in comparative cell biology to improve animal and human health. Theposition furthermore combines opportunities for teaching, scientific and academic qualification(Habilitation) and the development of independent research projects within the scope of the group.

Key Focus Areas:

• Independent experimental scientific research in comparative cell biology.

• Teaching and supervision of Bachelor, Master and PhD students/Habilitation.

• Coordination of lab setup and daily running.

• Contribution to the development and implementation of integrative analytical approaches forcell biology, biochemistry and molecular biology, incl. multi-omics, CRISPR/Cas-basedapproaches, imaging and bioinformatic image analysis.

• Support in the analysis of large datasets (e.g., RNA-seq, single-cell data and imaging).

• Support in the preparation of scientific publications and grant applications, for example for theGerman Research Foundation.

• Organization of scientific exchange activities, workshops and project meetings.

Recruitment requirements:

• A university degree and doctoral degree/PhD in (Molecular) Cell Biology, Biochemistry, MolecularBiology, Biology, Veterinary Medicine ("Approbation"), or a related discipline.

• Excellent written and spoken German and English language skills.

• Experience with, or strong interest in, multiscale imaging, CRISPR/Cas-based methods andprimary cell/tissue culture (organoids).

• Basic knowledge in the analysis of high-dimensional biological datasets, particularly microscopicdatasets.

• Knowledge of additional disciplines, including systems biology, gene regulation, epigenomics ormultiscale data integration, is advantageous.

Required professional knowledge and personal skills:

• Ability to communicate complex scientific concepts across disciplinary boundaries.

• Independent, structured and solution-oriented working style.

• Excellent organizational, communication and teamwork skills.

• Willingness to contribute to scientific coordination, develop independent research questions andparticipate in the preparation of publications and grant applications.

• Curious, strong analytical and conceptual thinking skills combined with the ability to developinnovative solutions.

• Flexibility and willingness to rapidly familiarize oneself with new technologies and researchareas.

What we offer:

• Special annual bonus

• Flexible working hours

• 30 days holiday

• Additional retirement arrangement: Pension Institution of the Federal Republic and the FederalStates (the company pension of the public service)

• Staff canteen with discount meal offers

• Participation in university sports at a discount

• Targeted further education and training opportunities

• Family friendliness

• Appreciative working atmosphere with contemporary management culture

The employment relationship is subject to the public sector collective agreement on the federalstates (TV-L). Severely disabled applicants will be given priority in the case of equal suitability. TheUniversity of Veterinary Medicine Hannover particularly wants to promote the professional equalityof men and women. Therefore, it strives to increase the underrepresented gender in the respective area.

Contact:

For more information, please contact Prof. Dr. Sjoerd van Wijk, Institute ofPhysiology and Cell Biology via telephone number +49 511 953-6119 or

Sjoerd.van.Wijk@tiho-hannover.de

When preparing your application, please include your CV, a motivation letter with ashort statement of your research plans and how your expertise would contribute tothe aims of our group, an overview of publications and third-party funding, as wellas the contact information of three referees. Applications should be submitted viaour online portal by 31.07.2026 at the latest.

All application documents will be destroyed after completion of the personnelselection process. Your personal data will be treated confidentially. Please see www.tiho-hannover.de/ds-bew for more information.

jobs.occupation: Product Quality Engineer (m/f/d) – Silicon Carbide (SiC) (Ingenieur/in - Elektrotechnik)
jobs.description:
Job Description

About the role

As a Product Quality Engineer, you will be expected to step into the game and display your excellent quality mindset to help drive our innovations beyond industry standards

What you will do

- Represent the Quality Management within the development team
- Correlate the SiC failure mechanisms with reliability measures to be implemented into the product quality
- Support the definition and execution of qualification activities for SiC product developments
- Contribute to the implementation of quality procedures and quality standards (Nexperia, JEDEC, AEC, and customer-specific) within projects
- Support the development, review, and verification of final test specifications
- Promote quality awareness and best practices to internal and external stakeholders
- Support customer requests and complaints handling activities
- Contribute to the identification and resolution of quality gaps in the product creation process
- Support the definition of qualification requirements and qualification of manufacturing processes
- Maintain documentation and handle data in analysis tools for Reliability, Yield, FMEA, Customer Requests, and related activities
- Perform analyses to identify root causes of yield loss or production issues and support the implementation of containment and corrective actions
- Prepare initial input for PCNs, support review and release activities, and contribute to follow-up actions

What you will need

- Master’s degree in Electronics Engineering, Physics or a similar discipline
- Experience in a similar position is desirable and experienced in wafer fab and assembly processes preferred
- Knowledge in semiconductor physics as well as in semiconductor applications in the SiC domain
- First knowledge of international quality standards and policies e.g. AEC-Q101, AQG 324
- Familiar with measurement methods and equipment as well as device testing environments
- Familiar with standard software tools (e.g. Office), problem solving techniques
- High-quality mindset and ability to work under pressure
- Fluent spoken and written English skills
- Strong know how in statistical data analysis
- Good communication and presentation skills
- Good team player and willingness to travel
- Assertiveness and demonstrated influencing skills
- Open mindset, which welcomes changes and views problems as opportunities

About the role

At Nexperia, we build around 100 billion essential semiconductors a year. These microchips are a crucial part of cars, mobiles, watches, white goods, mobility solutions – you name it. It is more than likely that all your gadgets carry one or more Nexperia chips.

We are headquartered in the Netherlands and have Frontend and Backend production sites across the globe.

Our Procurement is organized in a global matrix structure. We are an international team equipped with many years of solid industry knowledge and you will find it easy to integrate in our team if you identify with our working principles: take ownership, drive with perseverance, be efficient, and enjoy what you do.

We are searching for a Global Sourcing Manager for our Global NPR Team.

In this role you will

- be accountable for selected global NPR (non-product related) subcategories, such as People & Professional, IT, Utilities Management and others purchased for specific or all our Nexperia sites.
- develop robust and long-term sourcing strategies and roadmaps for the categories you own based on key suppliers, market position, technology capabilities, pricing development, and risk mitigation – in alignment with sr. leadership and key stakeholders.
- be building and nurturing long-term supplier partnerships focusing on the 4-Buy Principle (Buy Right, Buy Low, Buy Little, Buy On-Time) and Nexperia procurement processes, achieving best total cost of ownership for Nexperia.
- manage supplier performance for best-in-class supply base.
- drive synergy spends to consolidate count of suppliers and drive costs down on e.g. consumables.
- actively involving yourself in system and process related improvement projects.
- drive and support stakeholder management on procurement processes.
- give support to team colleagues as well as development to the team.

Ideally you have

- a commercial degree and >10 years of experience in semiconductor or similar industries.
- proven track record of sourcing roles.
- excellent English speaking and communication skills amongst various groups of stakeholders, also across borders (Tier 1+2 sites).
- proven negotiation and analytical skills.
- capability of thinking out of the box while continuously challenging the status quo.

Join D.Med Consulting GmbH – Pioneering Medical Device Technologies

D.Med Consulting GmbH, headquartered in Hamburg, Germany, is a joint venture between Fresenius Medical Care AG (51%) and the D.Med Healthcare Group (49%). Founded in 2011, we are a leading provider of research, development and consulting services specializing in extracorporeal therapies. The collaboration with Fresenius Medical Care, the world leader in renal care, and the D.Med Healthcare Group, a renowned provider in nephrology, cardiology, and internal medicine, allows us to offer a comprehensive range of services from concept to implementation. Join our team of dedicated professionals and contribute to groundbreaking advancements in medical device technology. Join us and experience a true partnership in innovation – working hand-in-hand to achieve our customer goals.

For our office in Hamburg and at the earliest possible starting date we are looking for a

Quality and Regulatory Affairs Manager Medical Devices (m/f/d)

Your responsibilities:

- Regulatory Analysis: Conducting regulatory GAP analyses and overseeing the interpretation and integration of applicable global regulatory requirements for medical devices into internal processes
- Technical Documentation: Creating, reviewing, and maintaining high-quality technical documentation in compliance with MDR, IVDR, and other relevant standards
- Market Access & Registration: Developing and managing market access and registration strategies for active and non-active medical devices, including Software as a Medical Device (SaMD), with focus on regulatory compliance
-  Quality Management Systems (QMS): Establishing, maintaining, and continuously improving Quality Management Systems (QMS) according to ISO 13485, including the preparation and maintenance of related documentation
- Regulatory Developments: Continuously monitoring and evaluating changes in global regulatory landscapes and implementing necessary updates to QMS and technical documentation
- Risk Management: Leading the identification, analysis, evaluation, and documentation of product-related risks for medical devices in accordance with ISO 14971, with a strong focus on quality and compliance
-  Safety Assessment: Assessing the safety relevance of hazards in close collaboration with cross-functional teams and ensuring alignment with regulatory and quality requirements

Your profile:

- Degree in medical technology, engineering, natural sciences, or a related technical field
- Several years of hands-on experience in quality management and/or regulatory affairs within the medical device industry
- In-depth understanding of MDR, ISO 13485, ISO 14971, IEC 62304, and risk and safety analysis methodologies (FMEA, FTA)
- Proven knowledge in product development and risk management, especially with systems combining hardware, software, and mechanics
- Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams
- Structured, independent, and goal-oriented working style
- Strong analytical thinking and sound decision-making capabilities
- Fluent in English; proficiency in German is a plus

What we offer: 

- A diversified and challenging environment combined with a high degree of freedom for the implementation of innovative ideas
- A permanent employment contract with performance-related pay at an international and promising employer
- A modern workplace in spacious and bright offices in the heart of Hamburg with a view of the River Elbe
- A supportive working atmosphere in a dynamic team with short decision paths
- An individually tailored “on the job” training and professional development opportunities
- Personal added values such as a company pension scheme, team events, employee discounts, bike leasing and much more

What do we rely on at ENCAVIS? The sun. The wind. And on you.
Welcome to Encavis! Our world is all about the power of the sun, the wind and the more than 400 people across our group who are working together to shape the energy system of the future in order to ensure a sustainable energy supply for future generations.
ENCAVIS Management GmbH & Co. KG is the holding company of ENCAVIS GmbH , one of Europe's leading electricity producers from renewable energies. We operate a broadly diversified portfolio of over 330 onshore wind farms, ground-mounted solar plants and battery storage facilities in 13 European countries with an installed capacity of more than 5 GW. And best of all, we are continuing to grow! Our subsidiaries, Stern Energy SpA , which operates throughout Europe as a specialist in technical services for photovoltaic systems, and Encavis Portfolio Management GmbH, which specialises in supporting institutional investors, complement our portfolio.

What does this mean for you? The opportunity to make a difference, to shape and change things. As part of a multinational team that enjoys helping to make the energy transition a success.

Acting as both a strategic PMO and trusted sparring partner to the CEO and C-Suite, the team drives the execution of the company’s most critical initiatives, ensures alignment across functions, and supports key decision-making processes. From shaping corporate strategy and monitoring performance to leading cross-functional transformation programs and preparing board-level materials, the CEO Office helps translate long-term ambitions into tangible business outcomes and serves as a catalyst for the next phase of Encavis’ growth. jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities 

Briese Chartering is an established Shipowner/Carrier based in Leer/Germany managing a modern and versatile fleet of short-sea and multipurpose (MPP) vessels ranging from 3,000 to 10,000 DWT with a strong focus on carriage of project cargo. For further information see: www.briese-chartering.com (http://www.briese-chartering.com/)   

We are seeking an experienced Chartering Broker to join our Intra-Europe Regional Trade desk. In this role you will hold commercial responsibility for maximizing the utilization and profitability of our owned and controlled tonnage. You will optimize vessel loops across Europe, securing high-yielding regional breakbulk and specialized project cargo stems by maintaining direct relationships with industrial charterers, shippers and project forwarders.

Negotiate charter parties directly with cargo owners and competitive brokers, protecting the company's commercial interests. 

Fleet Optimization & Chartering 

Fix our 3,000–10,000 DWT fleet on Voyage Charters and Contracts of Affreightment (COAs) across European trade routes (Baltic, North Sea, Continent, Mediterranean/Black Sea and North/West Africa). 

Optimize vessel routing and scheduling to minimize ballast days and maximize daily time charter equivalent returns.

Project Cargo & Voyage Estimation 

Evaluate and price specialized project cargo inquiries tailored to our vessels' capabilities. 

Perform precise voyage calculations including bunker tracking, port/terminal expenses, and laytime analysis to ensure optimal margins. 

Market Integration & Collaboration 

Leverage the north/central European shipping community while managing an active network of international chartering contacts. 

Work closely with our in-house operations and technical management teams in Leer to guarantee smooth post-fixture execution. 

Qualifications & Experience 

 Essential Criteria 

- Minimum 3 years of commercial experience on the owner’s side or with an exclusive broker specifically within the European short-sea or small-MPP sectors. 
- Solid understanding of 3k–10k DWT vessel capabilities including stowage configurations, deck strength and regional port/canal restrictions. 
- Deep knowledge of European trades including seasonal weather factors, ice clauses and short-sea port operations. 
- Fluency in English is required; proficiency in German is highly preferred given our regional hub and team integration. 

Core Skills 

- Commercial drive with a clear focus on asset P&L and strategic fleet positioning. 
- Proficiency in voyage estimation and other standard software tools (MS Office, Sedna, Netpas, etc.). 
- Existing network of direct project cargo clients, industrial shippers and European forwarders.
